data.track_wlan_band: Track Wi-Fi band per device (2.4 / 5 GHz)
data.enable_repeaters: Create repeaters as their own devices
data.ip_ranges: IP ranges (Name=Pattern, one line per range)
data.enable_system_stats: Read CPU and RAM of the box (experimental)
data.check_updates: Check for a new version daily
data.enable_dns_settings: Change DNS settings of the box (experimental)

data_description.track_address_source: This value is not part of the host list and costs one extra request per device. It rarely changes, so it runs on its own slower schedule.
data_description.address_source_interval: Only applies when IP type tracking is enabled.
data_description.track_wlan_band: Reads the list of connected devices for each Wi-Fi network (one request per network and update) so the card can show the frequency band. Only devices connected directly to the FRITZ!Box get a value.
data_description.enable_device_tracker: Creates a device_tracker (home/away) per network device for presence and automations. May result in many entities on large networks.
data_description.enable_repeaters: Creates a separate device with a connected status for every FRITZ! mesh repeater in the home network, plus a reboot button when the FRITZ!Box controls are enabled. It also adds a mesh sensor (FRITZ!Box + repeaters) and, with controls, the "Restart all FRITZ! devices" button. Devices whose reported model contains "Repeater" or "FRITZ!Box" are detected - including a second FRITZ!Box running as a Wi-Fi mesh repeater.
data_description.enable_controls: Creates switches for the Wi-Fi bands (2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, guest) and for the Wi-Fi MAC filter, plus buttons to reconnect, reboot and start a pairing (MAC filter temporarily off), and a reboot button per repeater when repeater devices are enabled. Availability and assignment depend on the model.
data_description.pairing_minutes: How long the MAC filter stays off during pairing before it switches itself back on. Applies to the "Start pairing" button and to the service when no duration is given.
data_description.ip_ranges: Creates a counter sensor per line, e.g. "Printers=192.168.2.*" for "Printers online: 2 of 3". The pattern uses the same syntax as the card field "IP filter" ("*"/"?" as wildcards, several patterns separated by a comma, "!" excludes). Empty = no range sensors.
data_description.enable_host_devices: Creates a Home Assistant device for each selected network device, with the manufacturer (from the MAC address) and a connected status. Off by default – every device creates a device and an entity.
data_description.host_device_filter: Which devices get their own device: same notation as the card filter "IP filter" (e.g. "192.168.2.*", separate several patterns with commas, "!" excludes; "*" selects all). Empty = none. At most 150 devices.
data_description.enable_system_stats: Reads CPU load, RAM usage and temperature through the box web interface (not TR-064, undocumented by AVM, FRITZ!OS dependent). Off by default; if the request fails only these values are missing.
data_description.enable_parental_control: Enables services that read access profiles and assign them to devices (e.g. "Blocked" for one hour). Uses the box web interface, not TR-064 – undocumented by AVM, FRITZ!OS dependent. Off by default.
data_description.check_updates: Asks GitHub once a day for the latest published version and shows a notice in the card (Controls) when a newer one is available. No data about you or your box is transmitted.
data_description.enable_dns_settings: Allows the “Change DNS settings” service to write DNS servers of the FRITZ!Box (internet IPv4/IPv6, local DNS in the home network). Uses the web interface REST API, not TR-064 – undocumented by AVM, FRITZ!OS dependent, writing not tested on real hardware. Reading and the preview (dry_run) always work. Off by default.
data_description.enable_static_ip: Allows the “Set static IP” service to assign a fixed IPv4 address to a device (Home Network → Network → edit device). Uses the web interface, not TR-064 – field names are assumed and not verified on any box. The preview (dry_run) always works. Off by default.

set_device_name.name: Rename device
set_device_name.description: Changes the display name of a network device on the FRITZ!Box. Up to 64 characters, no known character restriction (spaces and special characters are fine).

config_entry.name: FRITZ!Box (config entry)
config_entry.description: Only needed with more than one FRITZ!Box set up: selects which one this service applies to. Without it, the service affects the first loaded box.

wake_on_lan.name: Wake device
wake_on_lan.description: Sends a Wake-on-LAN signal to a network device.

config_entry.name: FRITZ!Box (config entry)
config_entry.description: Only needed with more than one FRITZ!Box set up: selects which one this service applies to. Without it, the service affects the first loaded box.

set_internet_access.name: Set internet access
set_internet_access.description: Blocks or allows a device's internet access (experimental, only on FRITZ!Boxes with the TR-064 HostFilter service).

blocked.name: Blocked
blocked.description: On = block internet access, Off = allow.

config_entry.name: FRITZ!Box (config entry)
config_entry.description: Only needed with more than one FRITZ!Box set up: selects which one this service applies to. Without it, the service affects the first loaded box.

minutes.name: Block duration (minutes)
minutes.description: Optional: after this time access is released automatically (only when blocking; checked at the polling interval).

set_mac_filter.name: Set MAC filter
set_mac_filter.description: Turns the Wi-Fi MAC filter (restrict access to known Wi-Fi devices) on or off permanently. Ends a running pairing.

enabled.name: Filter active
enabled.description: On = only known devices may join the Wi-Fi, off = any device with the correct Wi-Fi password.

config_entry.name: FRITZ!Box (config entry)
config_entry.description: Only needed with more than one FRITZ!Box set up: selects which one this service applies to. Without it, the service affects the first loaded box.

start_pairing.name: Start pairing
start_pairing.description: Turns the MAC filter off for a few minutes so a new device can join the Wi-Fi, then turns it back on automatically. Only works while the filter is on.

minutes.name: Duration (minutes)
minutes.description: How long the filter stays off. If omitted, the integration setting is used.

config_entry.name: FRITZ!Box (config entry)
config_entry.description: Only needed with more than one FRITZ!Box set up: selects which one this service applies to. Without it, the service affects the first loaded box.

reboot_mesh.name: Restart mesh
reboot_mesh.description: Restarts all FRITZ! devices: the repeaters first, then the FRITZ!Box. Repeaters that cannot be reached are skipped. The home network is offline for a few minutes afterwards.

config_entry.name: FRITZ!Box (config entry)
config_entry.description: Only needed with more than one FRITZ!Box set up: selects which one this service applies to. Without it, the service affects the first loaded box.

gast_wlan_info.name: Get guest Wi-Fi credentials
gast_wlan_info.description: Returns the guest Wi-Fi's SSID, on/off state and a QR code to connect - only as a return value, never as a sensor (so the password never ends up in an attribute or in history). Requires a separate guest Wi-Fi (WLANConfiguration, detected automatically - usually 3).

service.name: Service number
service.description: Only needed if the automatically detected service number is not the guest Wi-Fi (1-4, default: automatic).

config_entry.name: FRITZ!Box (config entry)
config_entry.description: Only needed with more than one FRITZ!Box set up: selects which one this service applies to. Without it, the service affects the first loaded box.

set_device_note.name: Save a note for a device
set_device_note.description: Saves a label, a note and the "reserved" mark for a network device – stored in Home Assistant only, the FRITZ!Box is not changed. Omitted fields stay unchanged; an empty text clears the field.

label.name: Label
label.description: Short label (up to 40 characters), e.g. "Kids room".

reserved.name: Reserved
reserved.description: Marks the address as reserved in the FRITZ!Box. The box does not report reservations inside the DHCP range – the device then counts as "fixed".

config_entry.name: FRITZ!Box (config entry)
config_entry.description: Only needed if several FRITZ!Boxes are set up: selects which one this service applies to. Without it, the service acts on the first loaded box.

update_oui.name: Update manufacturer list
update_oui.description: Downloads the IEEE registers (MA-L, MA-M, MA-S) and stores them in the "fritzbox_netzwerk" folder of the Home Assistant configuration. Your own entries from "oui_custom.txt" take precedence. The previous list stays if the download fails.

config_entry.name: FRITZ!Box (config entry)
config_entry.description: Only needed if several FRITZ!Boxes are set up: selects which one this service applies to. Without it, the service acts on the first loaded box.

list_access_profiles.name: List access profiles
list_access_profiles.description: Lists the parental-control access profiles (ID and name). Experimental, option required.

config_entry.name: FRITZ!Box
config_entry.description: With several boxes: which box is meant.

get_access_profile.name: Get access profile
get_access_profile.description: Returns the current access profile of a device. Experimental, option required.

config_entry.name: FRITZ!Box
config_entry.description: With several boxes: which box is meant.

set_access_profile.name: Set access profile
set_access_profile.description: Assigns an access profile to a device, optionally only for a set time. Experimental, option required.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: ID (filtprof…) or name of the access profile.

minutes.name: Duration (minutes)
minutes.description: Optional: afterwards the original profile is restored (checked at the polling interval).

config_entry.name: FRITZ!Box
config_entry.description: With several boxes: which box is meant.

install_blueprints.name: Install blueprints
install_blueprints.description: Copies the bundled blueprints (automations and script) into the Home Assistant blueprint folder. Existing modified files are left untouched unless "Overwrite" is set.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Also replace existing blueprint files that differ from the bundled ones.

config_entry.name: FRITZ!Box
config_entry.description: With several boxes: which box is meant.

get_dns_settings.name: Get DNS settings
get_dns_settings.description: Returns the DNS settings of the box (internet IPv4/IPv6, local DNS in the home network, DNS over TLS). Read-only, experimental.

config_entry.name: FRITZ!Box
config_entry.description: With several boxes: which box is meant.

set_dns_settings.name: Change DNS settings
set_dns_settings.description: Changes DNS servers of the box. Only the given fields change; the box is read first, checked afterwards and restored on mismatch. Experimental, option required (preview with dry_run always works). The box may ask for a confirmation.

internet_ipv4_custom.name: Internet IPv4: custom DNS servers
internet_ipv4_custom.description: On: “Use other DNSv4 servers” (Internet → Account Information → DNS Server).

internet_ipv4_dns1.name: Internet IPv4: preferred server
internet_ipv4_dns1.description: IPv4 address. Empty removes the entry.

internet_ipv4_dns2.name: Internet IPv4: alternative server
internet_ipv4_dns2.description: IPv4 address. Empty removes the entry.

internet_ipv6_custom.name: Internet IPv6: custom DNS servers
internet_ipv6_custom.description: On: “Use other DNSv6 servers” (Internet → Account Information → DNS Server).

internet_ipv6_dns1.name: Internet IPv6: preferred server
internet_ipv6_dns1.description: IPv6 address. Empty removes the entry.

internet_ipv6_dns2.name: Internet IPv6: alternative server
internet_ipv6_dns2.description: IPv6 address. Empty removes the entry.

home_ipv4_dns.name: Home network IPv4: local DNS server
home_ipv4_dns.description: IPv4 address (Home Network → Network → Network Settings → IPv4 addresses).

home_ipv6_dns.name: Home network IPv6: local DNSv6 server
home_ipv6_dns.description: IPv6 address (Home Network → Network → Network Settings → IPv6 addresses).

home_ipv6_advertise.name: Home network IPv6: announce via Router Advertisement
home_ipv6_advertise.description: Also announce the DNSv6 server via Router Advertisement (RFC 5006).

dry_run.name: Preview only
dry_run.description: Only shows what would change and writes nothing.

config_entry.name: FRITZ!Box
config_entry.description: With several boxes: which box is meant.

set_static_ip.name: Set static IP
set_static_ip.description: Assigns a fixed IPv4 address to a device and first checks that it is not already in use. The address only applies after the device is restarted or reconnected. Experimental, option required (preview with dry_run always works).

config_entry.name: FRITZ!Box
config_entry.description: With several boxes: which one is meant.

mark_devices_reserved.name: Mark several devices as "reserved"
mark_devices_reserved.description: Marks every device whose IP address matches the pattern as "reserved" in one go - stored in Home Assistant only, the FRITZ!Box is not changed. Useful because the box does not report reservations inside the DHCP range, so such devices would otherwise show as "dynamic". Use "Preview only" to see what would change first.

ip_filter.name: IP pattern
ip_filter.description: Pattern with wildcards, separate several with commas, "!" excludes, e.g. 192.168.178.*,!192.168.178.1. An empty pattern selects nothing.

reserved.name: Reserved
reserved.description: On: mark, off: remove the mark again.

dry_run.name: Preview only
dry_run.description: Only shows which devices would be affected and changes nothing.

config_entry.name: FRITZ!Box
config_entry.description: With several boxes: which box is meant.

repeater_no_ip.message: No IP address is currently known for the repeater {name}. Is it powered on and connected to the FRITZ!Box?

repeater_denied.message: The repeater {name} ({address}) rejected the login ({error}). Check that access for applications (TR-064) is allowed on the repeater and that it has taken over the FRITZ!Box credentials.

mac_filter_failed.message: Could not change the MAC filter: {error}

mac_filter_unsupported.message: This FRITZ!Box does not offer the MAC filter via TR-064 ({error}).

mac_filter_not_applied.message: The FRITZ!Box did not apply the MAC filter change ({error}). Please check the state in the FRITZ!Box interface.

pairing_filter_off.message: The MAC filter is off. Pairing only works while the filter is on, otherwise it would be switched on unexpectedly afterwards.

mesh_reboot_box_failed.message: The FRITZ!Box could not be restarted: {error} Repeaters restarted: {restarted}.

mesh_reboot_partial.message: The FRITZ!Box is restarting, but these repeaters could not be restarted: {names} ({error})

remote_access_no_tls_verification.title: Remote access without certificate verification
remote_access_no_tls_verification.description: Remote access via MyFRITZ!/HTTPS is enabled for {host}. The library used (fritzconnection) does not verify TLS certificates - a low risk on the local home network, but a higher one over the open internet (potentially man-in-the-middle). See the README section "Zugriff auf eine entfernte FRITZ!Box" for details. This notice disappears automatically once remote access is turned off again, in the options or via "Reconfigure".
